claim.claim-text: 2. The hinge assembly of claim 1, wherein the magnet is a neodymium magnet.
3. The hinge assembly of claim 1, wherein the receiver comprises a coated ferromagnetic insert positioned within a groove on an underside of the toilet lid.
4. The hinge assembly of claim 1, wherein the magnet includes a beveled edge configured to form a sealed fit with the receiver.
5. The hinge assembly of claim 4, wherein the beveled edge has an angle of about 3° to about 5°.
6. The hinge assembly of claim 1, wherein the magnet extends above an upper surface of the lid arm to project into the receiver when the lid is installed.
7. The hinge assembly of claim 1, wherein the hinge pin is cylindrical.
8. The hinge assembly of claim 1, wherein the magnet is coated with a non-porous corrosion-resistant layer selected from nickel, epoxy, or polymeric coatings.

9. The hinge assembly of claim 1, wherein the wherein the receiver and the magnet are shaped to self-center during engagement, thereby ensuring proper alignment of the toilet lid without manual positioning.
10. The hinge assembly of claim 1, wherein the magnet and the receiver are configured to generate a magnetic holding force of between about 5-20 newtons (N) when the lid is attached.
11. The hinge assembly of claim 1, wherein the receiver comprises a magnetically responsive disc formed from a ferromagnetic alloy selected from iron, low-carbon steel, or nickel-iron alloy.
13. The method of claim 12, wherein magnetically attaching the toilet lid comprises aligning the receiver groove on the underside of the lid with the magnet disposed in the lid arm.

14. The method of claim 12, wherein securing the mounting bracket comprises inserting a mechanical fastener through an aperture in the mounting bracket body and into a preformed hole in the toilet bowl.
15. The method of claim 12, wherein the hinge pin provides a rotational axis about which both the toilet seat and toilet lid independently pivot.
16. The method of claim 12, further comprising removing the toilet lid by applying an upward force sufficient to overcome a magnetic attraction between the magnet and the receiver.
17. The method of claim 12, further comprising replacing the toilet lid with a second toilet lid having a receiver configured to engage the magnet.

18. The method of claim 12, wherein attaching the lid arm comprises inserting the hinge pin into a bore formed in the lid arm and positioning a recessed region of the lid arm adjacent to a seat buffer.
19. The method of claim 12, wherein the magnetic attachment permits tool-free removal and reinstallation of the toilet lid by a user.

20. A method of using a toilet hinge assembly, comprising: raising and lowering a toilet seat and a toilet lid about a hinge pin supported by a mounting bracket; selectively detaching the toilet lid from the hinge assembly of claim 1 by lifting the lid to disengage a magnetic connection between the lid arm magnet disposed and the receiver in the lid; and replacing the detached toilet lid with a different toilet lid by lowering the different toilet lid into position such that the magnetic connection is reestablished without the use of tools.
